input_structure.policy: Only VOCAL_LINE is aligned. AMBIGUOUS is retained without timing; use explicit tags to resolve. Text classification is heuristic.

lyric_timeline.classification_rule: LYRICを既定値とし、SCAT/BREATH/VOCALIZATION/INSTRUMENTALは入力タグで明示する。音響だけから意味分類を確定しない。
limitations: 自動同期は候補値。重要箇所は手動補正を推奨

role_split.srt_asr: WHEN / 実発声時刻の観測

unmatched_vocal_events.note: 正規歌詞との一致が弱い/無いASR区間。スキャット等の候補だが意味分類は確定しない。

limitations: ASR誤認識を正規歌詞へ上書きしない
SCAT_CANDIDATEは候補分類で確定ではない

unified_timeline.rule: Independent streams on shared time axis
unified_timeline.relation_policy: Temporal overlap is not semantic agreement or causation.

sections.limitations: Includes any estimated lyric boundaries; not an acoustic section detection.

audio_events.note: Detector timestamps are estimates. RMS samples are observations of decoded audio, not calibrated loudness. Motion windows remain separate.

reference_identity.scope: source content SHA-256 when available, otherwise metadata; detector versions, semantic type and original coordinates
reference_identity.limitations: IDs are reproducible for identical inputs and conditions. Audio differences below metadata visibility are not distinguished in fallback mode. Text IDs include physical source line. Identical duplicate SRT cues use an occurrence suffix. Not a cryptographic identity guarantee.

review_items.reason: Content hashing was unavailable; metadata cannot distinguish different audio with identical metadata.
review_items.recommended_check: Use a secure context with Web Crypto and reanalyze when cross-file identity matters.
